narration: For {identical_months} months the two lives ran exactly the same. In month {fork_month} you chose {real_choice}, and the ghost took {ghost_choice}. The ghost's money touched its low in month {ghost_lowest_month}, then passed yours in month {crossover_month} and stayed ahead. At the layoff in month {layoff_month}, the ghost had {layoff_net_worth_gap}. By month {end_month}, the ghost had {net_worth_gap}. Less of the ghost's pay is spoken for before the month begins, its Freedom {freedom_gap}.
